Heroine Lekha brings her Sister in law Gauri from the village to the city in a train. She travels in a taxi with Gouri from the Railway Station to her house where she meets her friend Sushma and her husband. She introduces Gouri to Sushma and explains the reason of bringing Gouri together married to the boy Gouri wished to marry.
